payload.name: Attention tunneling
payload.fact: High cognitive load in immersive environments leads to reduced saccade amplitudes and eye eccentricity, indicating a more centered and less exploratory visual behavior.

provenance.title: An analysis of gaze behavior under multisensory cognitive load in immersive environments
provenance.quote_or_locus: Our results reveal consistent changes in oculomotor behavior under high cognitive load, characterized by reduced saccade amplitudes and eye eccentricity, together with increased pupil dilation. These patterns indicate a more centered and less exploratory visual behavior, consistent with attention tunneling under high task demands

decision_note: REJECT, NOT_TRANSFERABLE, delegated by owner. A symptom with no intervention. It describes narrowed saccade amplitudes and centred gaze under high load in immersive environments; both sides of the claim are measures, the antecedent is an internal state, and no manipulable variable is named anywhere in it.
